messages:
Samira: Huge props to Lina & Jamal for setting up the snack table this morning — saved our brains before the all-hands :tada:
Lina: ahhh thank you!! Jamal hauled two boxes of cookies up three flights of stairs :muscle:
Jamal: lol true. plant-based cookies were a hit :cookie: Also big shout to Marcus for bringing the french press and the good beans :coffee:
Marcus: happy to fuel the chaos. also thanks to Priya for organizing the cash box and sign-up list :raised_hands:
Priya: spreadsheet lives to serve. if anyone wants to add for next week, drop choices here or use the signup link:
Priya: ```https://tinyurl.com/rw-snack-signup — add item + date (no glassware in the sink pls)```
Samira: quick micro-poll — vote with emoji on your fav for next week: :one: Brownies, :two: Bagels, :three: Fruit platter
Lina: :one: Brownies all the way
Jamal: :three: Fruit — gotta balance out those cookies :banana:
Marcus: :two: Bagels (everything is better with lox)
KitchenBot: Reminder: Kitchen cleanup at 5:00pm. Leftovers go to the fridge labeled "snack-shelf" :fridge:
Priya: I can handle wipe-downs this Friday after standup :sweat_smile:
Samira: Amazing team energy today — tiny things like this make a big difference. thanks everyone :sparkles: (reactions: :tada: x6, :heart: x3)
